title.en: Seven Kingdoms of the Inner Sea

subtitle.zh-CN: 一场尚未散席的晚宴，一张等待展开的地图。
subtitle.en: A banquet still in progress. A map waiting to unfold.

chapterName.en: Seven Kingdoms of the Inner Sea

body.zh-CN: 长桌已经铺好，盘盏仍空。记录官先写下座次，再写窗外送进宫门的七种口音。
body.en: The long table has been laid, though every dish remains empty. The recorder writes down the seating order, then the seven accents drifting through the palace gate outside.

body.zh-CN: 侍者放下银盘，退到灯光之外。瓦罗王尝了一口，示意把窗边的烛台移近。
body.en: A server sets down the silver platter and steps out of the light. Varo tastes a mouthful, then asks for the candlestick by the window to be brought closer.

body.zh-CN: 酒杯重新斟满，席间开始谈论道路、港口和今年的收成，仿佛这些地方都只是货单上的来源。
body.en: The cups are filled again. Around the table they speak of roads, harbors, and this year's harvest, as if each place were merely an entry on a bill of goods.

body.zh-CN: 撤下的盘子越来越多，新的器皿仍不断送来。瓦罗王把杯子推到一旁，等待侍者揭开下一只银盖。
body.en: More plates are cleared while new vessels keep arriving. Varo pushes his cup aside and waits for the server to lift another silver cover.

body.zh-CN: 银盖揭开时，热气短暂遮住了桌对面的人。有人把窗推开，宫墙外已经接近深夜。
body.en: When the silver cover is lifted, steam briefly hides those seated across the table. Someone opens a window. Beyond the palace wall, it is almost midnight.

body.zh-CN: 长桌看起来比开席时更拥挤，也更空。每一道菜都留下器皿，却很少有人再交谈。
body.en: The long table looks more crowded than when the feast began, and emptier too. Every course leaves a vessel behind, but almost no one speaks now.

body.zh-CN: 瓦罗王的动作慢下来，仍不允许撤走下一只盘子。记录官的墨已经变淡，名字却还没有念完。
body.en: King Varo's movements slow, yet he will not allow the next plate to be removed. The recorder's ink has faded, but the list of names is not finished.

body.zh-CN: 最后一道菜失去热气，窗外出现灰白的天光。完整地图留在桌上，宴席到此结束。
body.en: The final course loses its warmth as gray daylight reaches the windows. The completed map remains on the table. The feast is over.

eyebrow.zh-CN: 后世档案 · 内海七国
eyebrow.en: Later archive · Seven Kingdoms of the Inner Sea

body.zh-CN:
完整地图在天明前被送出宴厅。瓦罗王让人给七国换上同一种颜色，仿佛边界从此只剩装饰。宫门外，运粮车仍沿着被改名的旧路驶来，车夫却继续使用那些已经从官册上消失的地名。

这个看似无边的政权没有维持多久。加税、征役和争位使各地接连起兵，宫廷卫队在瓦罗王死后第三年撤下王旗；七国的边界再度改变，流亡者却没有因此立刻归乡。帝国被推翻得很快，它留下的迁徙、空城与失传手艺却延续了几代人。
body.en:
The completed map left the banquet hall before dawn. King Varo ordered all seven kingdoms painted in a single color, as though their borders had become decoration. Outside the palace gate, grain carts still followed old roads under new names, while their drivers kept using place names already erased from official registers.

The government that seemed boundless did not last. Taxes, forced labor, and struggles for succession drove one province after another into revolt. In the third year after Varo's death, the palace guard lowered his standard. The borders of the seven kingdoms changed again, though the displaced did not immediately return home. The empire was overthrown quickly; the migrations, empty cities, and lost crafts it left behind endured for generations.

survivingTrace.zh-CN: 这张地图后来被拆成七卷，分别保存于港务所、修道院和旧税库。后世修复者保留了彼此矛盾的地名与边线：它既是瓦罗王权势顶点的自夸，也是各国曾经存在、抵抗并留下痕迹的证物。
survivingTrace.en: The map was later separated into seven rolls and kept among harbor offices, monasteries, and abandoned tax houses. Later restorers preserved its contradictory place names and boundary lines. It is at once a boast from the height of Varo's power and evidence that the kingdoms existed, resisted, and left traces behind.

chapter.en: Seven Kingdoms of the Inner Sea

geography.zh-CN: 低地河网与季节性湿原

fallChronology.zh-CN: 瓦罗王征战第十年 · 融雪月

foodAndMaterialCulture.zh-CN: 榆烟熏鱼、酸草、河闸铜器与芦苇编席。
foodAndMaterialCulture.en: Elm-smoked fish, sour herbs, bronze sluiceware, and woven reed mats.

banquetInsert.zh-CN: 榆烟从低地鱼棚的屋顶升起来。白鱼抹上粗盐和酸草，留到河水结冰后食用。
banquetInsert.en: Elm smoke rises from the lowland fish sheds. White fish is rubbed with coarse salt and sour herbs, then kept until the river freezes.

fallCardBody.zh-CN:
洛汶议会原以为拆去东堤就能拖慢帝国骑兵，却先让三座村镇失去了归路。榆堤城在第六日开门，守闸人把铜钥匙沉进河心，没有参加受降仪式。

春水退去后，帝国测绘官把那三座村镇涂成一片无人湿地；幸存者仍按旧钟声渡河，仿佛纸上的空白从未发生。
fallCardBody.en:
The Loven council believed that dismantling the eastern dike would slow the imperial cavalry. Instead, three villages lost their way home. Elm Dike opened its gates on the sixth day; the keeper sank the bronze key in midstream and did not attend the surrender.

When the spring water withdrew, imperial surveyors painted the three villages as empty marsh. Those who survived still crossed at the old bell, as though the blank place on the map had never happened.

survivingTrace.zh-CN: 后世修闸时捞出一枚没有齿纹的铜钥匙，现藏于榆堤档案室。
survivingTrace.en: Centuries later, repairs to the sluice brought up a toothless bronze key, now kept in the Elm Dike archive.

mapRevealConcept.zh-CN: 河网与闸门从褪色底图中显现，沉入河心的铜钥匙留作完成印记。
mapRevealConcept.en: Waterways and sluice gates emerge from the faded ground; the key sunk in midstream remains as the mark of completion.

arrival.zh-CN: 榆烟从低地鱼棚的屋顶升起来。白鱼抹上粗盐和酸草，留到河水结冰后食用。
arrival.en: Elm smoke rises from the lowland fish sheds. White fish is rubbed with coarse salt and sour herbs, then kept until the river freezes.

halfway.zh-CN: 榆堤的厨师在木板上晾鱼，不在鱼身上刻记号。每家人认得自家的那一块木板。
halfway.en: The cooks of Elm Dike dry fish on boards, without marking the fish. Each household recognizes its own board.

chapter.en: Seven Kingdoms of the Inner Sea

geography.en: Northern stone slopes and salt-road stations

fallChronology.zh-CN: 瓦罗王征战第七年 · 盐路封冻前
fallChronology.en: Campaign Year Seven · before the salt road froze

foodAndMaterialCulture.zh-CN: 茴香热乳酪、白陶碗、盐路商队与石阶驿站。
foodAndMaterialCulture.en: Hot fennel cheese, white pottery, salt-road caravans, and stone-stepped stations.

banquetInsert.zh-CN: 阿斯帕的热乳酪盛在白陶碗里，茴香放得很轻。客人总在碗沿找一块没烫手的地方。
banquetInsert.en: Aspa serves hot cheese in white clay bowls with a little fennel. Guests search the rim for a place cool enough to hold.

fallCardTitle.en: The Empty Flag Above White Stair

fallCardBody.zh-CN:
阿斯帕的执政官把军旗留在城墙上，带着卫队从盐路撤往北坡。帝国军抵达时只找到开着的仓库与一份逐户抄写的欠粮名册；留下的人用那份名册证明征粮早已超过约定。

证明没有换来归还。抄写员把名册裁成细条，缝进商队的鞍垫，让每一处盐路驿站都保存一小段欠下的粮。
fallCardBody.en:
Aspa's governor left the army flag on the wall and withdrew with the guard along the salt road toward the northern slope. Imperial troops found only open storehouses and a household ledger of grain debts; those who remained used it to prove that the levy had already exceeded its promise.

The proof won back nothing. Scribes cut the ledger into strips and sewed them into caravan saddles, leaving every salt-road station with a fragment of the grain still owed.

survivingTrace.zh-CN: 白阶城至今仍把空旗日记作一年中不开市的上午。
survivingTrace.en: White Stair still observes Empty Flag Day as the one morning each year when its markets do not open.

mapRevealConcept.zh-CN: 盐路沿白色石阶延伸，城墙上只留下没有旗面的旗杆。
mapRevealConcept.en: The salt road climbs the white steps; above the wall stands a flagstaff without a flag.

arrival.zh-CN: 阿斯帕的热乳酪盛在白陶碗里，茴香放得很轻。客人总在碗沿找一块没烫手的地方。
arrival.en: Aspa serves hot cheese in white clay bowls with a little fennel. Guests search the rim for a place cool enough to hold.

halfway.zh-CN: 商队把空碗倒扣在车上。雨来时，乳酪的气味先于车轮抵达镇子。
halfway.en: Caravans carry empty bowls upside down. When rain arrives, the smell of cheese reaches town before the wheels.

chapter.en: Seven Kingdoms of the Inner Sea

fallChronology.zh-CN: 瓦罗王征战第九年 · 雾季末
fallChronology.en: Campaign Year Nine · close of the fog season

foodAndMaterialCulture.zh-CN: 黑壳贝、海藻酒、铜制贝盆与领港灯塔。
foodAndMaterialCulture.en: Black-shell mussels, seaweed wine, copper shell basins, and pilot beacons.

banquetInsert.zh-CN: 风井港的贝壳在晨光里泛黑。摊主只用清水煮它们，把海藻酒留给等得最久的人。
banquetInsert.en: Windwell Harbor's mussel shells look black in morning light. Vendors boil them in water and save the seaweed wine for those who wait longest.

fallCardTitle.en: The Harbor Bell Did Not Ring

fallCardBody.zh-CN:
迦蓝岬依靠海雾掩护船队多年。最后一夜，领港人故意熄掉外湾灯塔，让本国商船先离港；帝国舰队直到天亮才发现港内只剩拆去桅杆的旧船。

离港者被官册登记为溺亡，留下的人则被登记为无主户。许多年后，异地寄回的海图仍把风井港画作出发点，而不是帝国的新锚地。
fallCardBody.en:
For years Cape Galan hid its fleet in sea fog. On the final night, the pilots darkened the outer beacon so their merchant ships could leave first. At dawn, the imperial fleet discovered that the harbor held only old vessels stripped of their masts.

The departed were entered in the rolls as drowned; those who stayed were listed as households without owners. Charts sent home years later still marked Windwell as a place of departure, not the empire's new anchorage.

survivingTrace.zh-CN: 外湾灯塔重建后仍保留一段不点灯的石阶，领港人称它为静夜。
survivingTrace.en: The rebuilt outer beacon still keeps one flight of steps unlit. Harbor pilots call it the Quiet Night.

mapRevealConcept.zh-CN: 海岬、雾带与空锚地恢复轮廓，灯塔保留一段永不着色的石阶。
mapRevealConcept.en: Capes, fog banks, and empty anchorages regain their outlines; one stair of the beacon remains forever uncolored.

arrival.zh-CN: 风井港的贝壳在晨光里泛黑。摊主只用清水煮它们，把海藻酒留给等得最久的人。
arrival.en: Windwell Harbor's mussel shells look black in morning light. Vendors boil them in water and save the seaweed wine for those who wait longest.

halfway.zh-CN: 港口每天收走一车空贝壳。孩子们按大小把它们排开，直到潮水抹掉昨天的顺序。
halfway.en: A cart of empty shells leaves the harbor each day. Children sort them by size until the tide erases yesterday's arrangement.

chapter.en: Seven Kingdoms of the Inner Sea

geography.en: Valley wheat fields and watermills on both banks

fallChronology.zh-CN: 瓦罗王征战第八年 · 麦收后
fallChronology.en: Campaign Year Eight · after the wheat harvest

foodAndMaterialCulture.zh-CN: 砂壳麦面包、水磨石、木渡船与沿岸木工。
foodAndMaterialCulture.en: Sand-crusted wheat bread, millstones, wooden ferries, and riverside carpentry.

banquetInsert.zh-CN: 图兰的面包在出炉后才标重量。磨坊主说，等它凉下来，河谷就会少掉一点东西。
banquetInsert.en: Turan's bread is weighed straight from the oven. The miller says that once it cools, the valley will have lost a little of something.

fallCardTitle.en: The Ninth Boat at the Crossing

fallCardBody.zh-CN:
图兰河谷答应交出八条渡船，暗中留下第九条接送逃离磨坊渡的人。告密者领帝国军来到河边时，船已被拆成门板、车轴和三十多把木铲，分散在沿岸村落。

帝国随后收走了水磨石，河谷人便在夜里轮流使用仅存的一座小磨坊。多年间，谁家门板上出现旧船钉，谁家就先得到一袋新麦。
fallCardBody.en:
Turan Valley agreed to surrender eight ferries, keeping a ninth to carry people away from Mill Crossing. By the time an informer led imperial troops to the river, the boat had become doors, cart axles, and more than thirty wooden shovels scattered among the riverside villages.

The empire then took the millstones, so the valley shared its last small mill by night. For years, any household whose door showed an old boat nail received the first sack of new wheat.

survivingTrace.zh-CN: 河谷婚礼仍会赠送一把没有上漆的小木铲，据说木料来自那条船。
survivingTrace.en: Valley weddings still include the gift of a small unpainted wooden shovel, said to be cut from that boat.

mapRevealConcept.zh-CN: 蜿蜒河道与第九条渡船的尾波重回图上，航迹在村落间分解为细小木纹。
mapRevealConcept.en: The winding river and the ninth ferry's wake return to the map, dissolving among the villages into fine lines of wood grain.

arrival.zh-CN: 图兰的面包在出炉后才标重量。磨坊主说，等它凉下来，河谷就会少掉一点东西。
arrival.en: Turan's bread is weighed straight from the oven. The miller says that once it cools, the valley will have lost a little of something.

halfway.zh-CN: 渡船载着麦袋过河时，船夫用一块面包垫住摇晃的灯。到了对岸，他把面包带走。
halfway.en: When sacks of wheat cross the river, the ferryman wedges a piece of bread beneath a swaying lamp. On the far bank, he takes the bread with him.

chapter.en: Seven Kingdoms of the Inner Sea

geography.en: Inner-sea uplands and stone-bridge trade roads

fallChronology.zh-CN: 瓦罗王征战第十二年 · 围城第四十一日
fallChronology.en: Campaign Year Twelve · the forty-first day of the siege

foodAndMaterialCulture.zh-CN: 七桥香草、烤禽、石拱商道与桥市行会。
foodAndMaterialCulture.en: Seven-bridge herbs, roast fowl, stone-arch trade roads, and bridge-market guilds.

banquetInsert.zh-CN: 梅罗萨的桥市各卖一种香草。厨师若要凑齐一束，就得在城里走完七座桥。
banquetInsert.en: Each of Melosa's bridge markets sells one herb. A cook gathering a complete bunch must cross all seven bridges.

fallCardBody.zh-CN:
梅罗萨在六座桥上布防，却把最旧的第七桥留给逃难者。守军投降后，帝国史官把那座桥从军图中抹去，因为它证明围城并不完整，也证明有人在封锁中离开。

逃难者在山路上拆掉路牌，不让追兵知道桥通往哪里。后来重修商道的人找回了桥，却只找回彼此矛盾的三个旧名。
fallCardBody.en:
Melosa fortified six bridges and left the oldest, the seventh, to those fleeing the city. After the garrison surrendered, imperial historians erased it from their campaign map, because it proved both that the siege had gaps and that people escaped through them.

The refugees removed the mountain road signs so no pursuit would know where the bridge led. When the trade road was rebuilt, surveyors found the bridge again—and three old names that contradicted one another.

survivingTrace.zh-CN: 后世地图恢复了第七桥的位置，但桥名一栏至今空白。
survivingTrace.en: Later maps restored the seventh bridge, though the space reserved for its name remains blank.

mapRevealConcept.zh-CN: 最旧那座桥的桥面与桥墩重新显影，图上仍没有它的名字。
mapRevealConcept.en: The deck and piers of the oldest bridge surface again; the map still gives it no name.

arrival.zh-CN: 梅罗萨的桥市各卖一种香草。厨师若要凑齐一束，就得在城里走完七座桥。
arrival.en: Each of Melosa's bridge markets sells one herb. A cook gathering a complete bunch must cross all seven bridges.

halfway.zh-CN: 烤禽送到桌边时，香草已经失去颜色。识货的客人仍能依气味说出它们来自哪座桥。
halfway.en: By the time the roast bird reaches the table, the herbs have lost their color. Those who know them can still name the bridges by scent.

chapter.en: Seven Kingdoms of the Inner Sea

geography.en: Salt marshes, high dikes, and dye works

fallChronology.zh-CN: 瓦罗王征战第十一年 · 紫盐月
fallChronology.en: Campaign Year Eleven · Violet Salt Month

foodAndMaterialCulture.zh-CN: 紫盐炖梨、盐罐、染缸与高堤作坊。
foodAndMaterialCulture.en: Pears stewed with violet salt, salt jars, dye vats, and workshops along the high dikes.

banquetInsert.zh-CN: 乌尔珊的梨在铜锅里慢慢炖软。紫盐只放几粒，掌勺的人却总要数两遍。
banquetInsert.en: Urshan's pears soften slowly in a copper pot. Only a few grains of violet salt are added, but the cook always counts twice.

fallCardTitle.en: The Seal in the Dye Vat

fallCardBody.zh-CN:
乌尔珊宫廷在政变中更换了三次城门口令。最后一位守将把旧王印投入染缸，向帝国使者声称国家已经没有可以签署降书的人。围城仍继续了十二日。

染坊停火后，高堤水渠仍有数月呈淡紫色。帝国把那颜色记作胜利庆典的染料，作坊账册却说，那是被倒掉的冬衣与未交付的布。
fallCardBody.en:
During the coup, Urshan's court changed the gate password three times. The final commander threw the old royal seal into a dye vat and told the imperial envoy that no one remained who could sign a surrender. The siege continued for twelve more days.

After the dye works went cold, the high-dike channels remained pale violet for months. The empire recorded the color as dye for a victory festival; workshop ledgers called it winter clothing and cloth that would never be delivered.

survivingTrace.zh-CN: 紫盐堡出土的王印被染料蚀去一角，无法确认最后使用它的是哪一位君主。
survivingTrace.en: A royal seal excavated at Violet Salt Keep has one corner eaten away by dye. No one can determine which ruler used it last.

mapRevealConcept.zh-CN: 盐沼和高堤转为暗紫色，缺角王印作为档案页的压印。
mapRevealConcept.en: Salt marshes and high dikes deepen to violet; the broken seal leaves its impression on the archive page.

arrival.zh-CN: 乌尔珊的梨在铜锅里慢慢炖软。紫盐只放几粒，掌勺的人却总要数两遍。
arrival.en: Urshan's pears soften slowly in a copper pot. Only a few grains of violet salt are added, but the cook always counts twice.

halfway.zh-CN: 盐罐留在桌边，盖子下面垫着折好的纸。宴席结束以后，侍者会把纸展开晾干。
halfway.en: The salt jar stays beside the table, with folded paper under its lid. After the meal, a server unfolds the paper to dry.

chapter.en: Seven Kingdoms of the Inner Sea

geography.en: Eastern islets, shingle beaches, and shallow bays

fallChronology.zh-CN: 瓦罗王征战第六年 · 退潮季

foodAndMaterialCulture.zh-CN: 浅金小蟹、渔叉、船帆与海蚀洞储粮。
foodAndMaterialCulture.en: Pale-gold shore crabs, fishing spears, sails, and grain stores in sea caves.

banquetInsert.zh-CN: 佩尔岛退潮时，孩子们从石缝里捉小蟹。入夜后，温热的蟹壳在盘中泛着浅金。
banquetInsert.en: At low tide, Pel's children catch small crabs between the stones. After dark, the warm shells gleam pale gold on a plate.

fallCardBody.zh-CN:
佩尔岛没有城墙。岛民把粮食和船帆藏进海蚀洞，随后在砾湾列队交出渔叉。帝国记录把这写成一次迅速而体面的归顺，却没有记下当年冬天所有船只都被征走。

失去船的人沿着退潮线步行去相邻村落，用晒干的小蟹换粮。老人把海蚀洞的位置编进一首没有文字的数潮歌，只在孩子第一次独自赶海时教给他们。
fallCardBody.en:
Pel Island had no walls. Its people hid grain and sails in sea caves, then lined up at Shingle Bay to surrender their fishing spears. Imperial records called it a swift and dignified submission, but did not record that every boat was requisitioned that winter.

Without boats, people walked the low-tide line to neighboring villages and traded dried shore crabs for grain. Elders set the sea caves into an unwritten tide-counting song, taught only when a child first went to the shore alone.

survivingTrace.zh-CN: 岛上的旧历法把那一年称作无帆之冬，而不是瓦罗王纪年的第一年。
survivingTrace.en: The island's old calendar calls that year the Winter Without Sails, not the first year of King Varo's reign.

mapRevealConcept.zh-CN: 小岛海岸完整显现，但近岸不再绘出任何船帆。
mapRevealConcept.en: The island's coast appears in full, but no sail is drawn in its waters.

arrival.zh-CN: 佩尔岛退潮时，孩子们从石缝里捉小蟹。入夜后，温热的蟹壳在盘中泛着浅金。
arrival.en: At low tide, Pel's children catch small crabs between the stones. After dark, the warm shells gleam pale gold on a plate.

halfway.zh-CN: 岛上的汤用海水调咸淡。厨师舀汤之前会先看潮线，像是在看一只走得很慢的钟。
halfway.en: On the island, seawater seasons the soup. Before serving, the cook checks the tide line, as though consulting a very slow clock.
